mapper.sql: WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(u.email) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\\' OR LOWER(u.display_name) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\\') AND u.status=#{status} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_member omf WHERE omf.user_id=u.id AND omf.organization_id=#{organizationId})

SELECT u.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id=om.organization_id WHERE om.user_id=u.id AND om.status='ACTIVE' AND o.status='ACTIVE' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL) active_organization_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm_member fm JOIN farm f ON f.id=fm.farm_id WHERE fm.user_id=u.id AND fm.status='ACTIVE' AND f.status='ACTIVE' AND f.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL) active_farm_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm f JOIN farm_member fm ON fm.farm_id=f.id AND fm.user_id=u.id AND fm.role='FARM_OWNER' AND fm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE f.owner_user_id=u.id AND f.status='ACTIVE' AND f.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL) owned_active_farm_count FROM users u

SELECT f.*,o.name organization_name,o.org_type,owner.display_name owner_name,owner.email owner_email, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm_member fm WHERE fm.farm_id=f.id AND fm.status='ACTIVE') active_member_count FROM farm f JOIN organization o ON o.id=f.organization_id JOIN users owner ON owner.id=f.owner_user_id
